description: This file declares functions, macros, external variables, and conditional definitions related to Memory Technology Devices (MTD) operations, likely for embedded systems or firmware components. It includes interface functions for opening, checking, erasing, writing, and parsing MTD devices, as well as target-specific weakly-linked functions for firmware fixes and recovery procedures.
